conclusions: Official browser UI warns that deletion can remove related offset/write-off/income records; do not assume zero aggregate components prove no associations.
The browser uses /cashier/account/delete.rjson; its warning is risk evidence, not proof that the distinct public V2 endpoint has identical implementation.
The browser blocks certificateId and disabled accountStatus; public list display text alone is not a sufficient certificate check when IDs are provided.
Browser detailWriteOff uses /cashier/writeOff/detail.rjson, not an established public V2 endpoint. Do not forge its URL under the appKey API.
Browser UI includes otherMoneyObj and isCashJournal behavior. Public V2 journalId and full linkage semantics remain unqualified.
